title: Is Even Function
description:
Define a function `is_even(n)` that returns `True` if n is even, `False` otherwise. Print the results of calling `is_even(4)` and then `is_even(7)`, each on its own line.

**Expected output:**
```
True
False
```
starterCode:
def is_even(n):
    # Return True if n is even, False otherwise
    pass

print(is_even(4))
print(is_even(7))
hint: return n % 2 == 0 directly returns True or False.
